def _qp_key(worker_sha, spec_canon, beta_hex):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(worker_sha.encode("ascii")); h.update(spec_canon.encode("utf-8")); h.update(beta_hex.encode("ascii"))
    return h.hexdigest()[:24]
